decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is a flagship of the firm's automated circulation plants, and long investment cycles in precast plants justify keeping it despite a weaker German construction market.
The de-shuttering robot is a modular component of integrated lines, but it overlaps with the combined robot, so consolidation is a moderate risk; it remains useful for retrofits and modernizations.
Automatic shuttering is central to the firm's strategy of automated, standardized precast production for affordable housing, so the firm will likely keep offering it.
The newly launched multi-model line of magazining, cleaning and plotting machines fits the firm's pallet circulation offer and needs time to reach customers.
Production analysis software is cheap to maintain, supports the lifecycle service business and digitalization trends, and strengthens customer lock-in.
